'''Squallville''' (Japanese: '''ウインドタウン''' ''Wind Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]. Strong wind currents frequently blow through the area, hence its name. It is also surrounded by mountains and cliffs.

It was featured in ''[[DP118|Pursuing a Lofty Goal!]]''. A [[PokéRinger]] competition was held in the town in which {{Ash}}, [[Paul]], and [[James]] competed. Ash won the competition, with his {{p|Staravia}} evolving into {{AP|Staraptor}}.

==Trivia==
* This is one of the very few locations created before the release of {{g|Sword and Shield}} that is a town or city that does not end in "Town", "City", or "Village".
